## Claim delta

None, or the exact change to statements, input domains, definitions and assumptions.
This report orients review; the diff determines the tier.

## Tier 1 files touched

List paths and why each changed. Use verification/review-policy.json and the
proof-body classification procedure in guides/human_review.md.

## Commands and results

Separate ordinary tests, formal acceptance (revision, report, scope) and external
assumptions. Include the committed policy-trace tests and their results.

## Unresolved work

Failures, missing evidence, resource limits and required hosting configuration.

## Human approval record

To be completed by the human reviewer, not the authoring agent:

- Approved claim delta:
- Reviewed revision:
- Evidence scope/report:
- Remaining assumptions or unresolved questions:
- Reviewer and approval reference:
